_ruling: Product Owner, 2026-07-31: apply the near matches that the build had rejected,
holding only the two that are factually false — 'Unavailable' (matched 'available',
the opposite meaning) and '01 – 15 Jul' (matched '1–5 Jul', different dates).
These 17 are kept separate from accepted-suggestions.json because they were applied
on the owner's instruction over a stated objection, not because the match is sound.
Each carries the reservation that was raised. A translation reviewer should read this
file as a list to re-check, not as approved copy.

Mode.reservation: 'Model' is a different concept; here Mode is physical vs virtual visit

Assigned inspectors.reservation: singular Arabic on a plural label

Visits.reservation: carries the literal count 2; the label is a section title with no count

Visit.reservation: carries the literal count 1; the label is a table column header

Visit configuration.reservation: reads 'risk configuration'; the screen configures a visit, not risk

Approve.reservation: past participle on an action button that needs the imperative

Reject.reservation: past participle on an action button that needs the imperative

Exception.reservation: plural Arabic on a singular section title

Planned window.reservation: 'planning window' is the period plans are made in, not the planned visit window

Product.reservation: plural Arabic on a singular table cell value

Item.reservation: plural Arabic on a singular column header

due 1d.reservation: COMPOSED, not a catalogue string, and not a near match — the index holds no term for 'due' at all. Built only from fragments that are approved: خلال ('within') from 'Schedule a re-inspection within 14 days' -> 'جدولة إعادة تفتيش خلال 14 يومًا' and 'Planning window expires in 2 days' -> 'نافذة التخطيط تنتهي خلال يومين', plus the singular يوم from '1 day ago' -> 'قبل يوم'. Reads as time remaining, which is what the SLA column means, and introduces no new vocabulary — but a translator may prefer an explicit مستحقة خلال يوم. Needs confirmation.

overdue 1d.reservation: COMPOSED, not a catalogue string. Owner ruling 2026-07-31 required 1d and 2d to stay distinct, which the bare match 'overdue' -> متأخرة could not do. Built from the approved duration template 'Fire alarm test overdue by 41 days' -> 'اختبار إنذار الحريق متأخر 41 يومًا', taking the feminine متأخرة the catalogue uses for the bare term and the singular يومًا. Needs a translator's confirmation.

overdue 2d.reservation: COMPOSED, not a catalogue string. Same template as 'overdue 1d', with the dual يومين taken from the approved '2 days ago' -> 'قبل يومين'. Needs a translator's confirmation.

Section.reservation: reads 'inspection'; the column lists the package section an item belongs to

State.reservation: reads 'started'; the column is a state, not a start event

Actor.reservation: reads 'factory'; the audit column names who performed the action
